messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered P-27431: High 5xx rate on ingress-usw2. 502 spike across ingress pool. Current 5xx rate: ~22% (1-2m). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. PD: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/P-27431
sre-oncall: acked — taking triage. I'll start rolling checks on ingress nodes. @eng-infra please standby.
pagerduty: Incident P-27431 acknowledged by sre-oncall (on-call)
raj: seeing lots of TCP RST + keepalive errors on node-ingress-12. nginx logs: "upstream prematurely closed connection" and repeated `worker process died` entries.
kelly: taking node-ingress-12 OOS from LB, setting weight=0 in envoy, running `kubectl cordon node-ingress-12` now :wrench:
eng-infra: recommend `kubectl rollout restart deploy/ingress-nginx -n infra` for the pool after we drain. prepping config diff for nginx tunables (keepalive timeout)
michael: customer impact ~18% of incoming requests 502, support notified and we should prepare a brief update for affected customers.
sre-oncall: enabling failover routing to eu-west1 for critical routes, increasing retry budget temporarily (1->2). watch for latency increase.
raj: after removing ingress-12 and enabling retries, 5xx rate dropped to ~5% within 3m. continuing roll restarts across node-ingress-11..15.
kelly: rolling restart started, doing 2 nodes at a time. will post when pool is back to healthy.
incident-bot: PagerDuty P-27431 updated: status acknowledged, owner=sre-oncall, runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingress-502
michael: confirming we should keep fallback enabled until we see <1% 5xx for 10m. prepping postmortem skeleton.
raj: logs attached: ```
[2025-06-02T03:45:12Z] ingress-nginx worker[PID]: upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream
[2025-06-02T03:45:13Z] kernel: TCP: unexpected RST from 10.4.2.12: connection reset
```
kelly: quick note — no DB errors observed, looks network/proxy layer. :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: will keep this thread updated, if 5xx resurges I'll escalate to platform lead. closing for now when metrics stable.
